item.title: March 1, 2012: Man who kept his mother in freezer says he’s not coming back to the La Crosse area
item.description: Philip Schuth has no intentions of returning to the “cesspool by the Mississippi” when he is released from prison next month, according to a jailhouse letter received this week by the Tribune.
